title: HireAssist Recruiting Assistant

structured_fields.Tasks performed: Summarise applications, Answer candidate questions, Draft screening notes
structured_fields.Data processed: Work history and experience, Skills and qualifications, Contact details, Protected characteristics

intended_use: The system assists recruiters by summarising work history, skills, qualifications, contact details, and protected characteristics to answer candidate questions and draft screening notes. It informs recruiter decisions by recommending whether to advance a candidate or send a rejection email, with human oversight required before any action is executed.
known_limits: Candidate resumes may contain unverified statements or prompt injections. The model does not verify educational credentials or legal work authorisation, requiring human review to confirm these details.
